td.p: Acceptance criterion: For a starting object with multiple traceability types, the reader can identify and activate a separate plus-sign control for each type.

td.p: Review note: Empty relationship types have no expansion control; see Indicate objects without re... (STV_SHR_029). Incoming and outgoing relationships use separate controls with model-defined directional labels; see Distinguish incoming and ou... (STV_SHR_035).
